requirements.contract: Exact sources, platform limits, advisory/license/unsafe inventory and future crypto boundary.
Executable HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 behavior and buffered-body baseline.
Default-off validated feature and listener contract; invalid provider combinations rejected.
Exact stock profile includes PHP, ACME and telemetry; no implicit Wasm or changes to full.
Acyclic shared body API, lifetime/admission/cancellation and first-byte memory proofs for TCP before H3.
Private transport/TLS adapters, existing crypto-owner allowlist, no Brynja dependency.
TLS1.3, h3 ALPN, SNI, client auth, generations and provider rejection without fallback.
Owned supervised IPv4/IPv6 sockets, startup rollback, no generic UDP dispatch.
Bound handshake/connection/buffer work, authenticated tokens, anti-amplification, global/prefix limits.
Seamless validated NAT rebinding and active client migration preserve connections and streams, with peer-policy re-evaluation, bounded prefix accounting and failed-path recovery.
Required control streams, bounded fields, static/literal QPACK only; local dynamic capacity and blocked streams zero.
Bounded parsing and fair default scheduling; no promise of advanced priority scheduling.
Pseudo-header/authority/content-length validation, body budget, trailers, resets and timeouts.
Shared streaming/backpressure, informational policy, no-body statuses, cancellation and completion.
Vhosts, static/range/conditional/digest, redirects and generated errors preserve TCP semantics.
Existing H1/H2 TLS/mTLS origins and PHP/FastCGI, streaming/spooling limits and safe retry/cancellation.
Auth, Host/IP policy, forwarding, headers, CORS and denial parity.
Cache/compression/digest, load-balancing and optional Wasm, bounded retained state and cancellation.
Bounded metrics/traces/admin/logs, private opt-in diagnostics, no public secrets/topology.
Generation-safe TCP/H3 publication, independent route/cert transactions, background LB route reload rejected.
Eligible ready-only Alt-Svc, GOAWAY/deadlines, cached-advertisement blocked-UDP client recovery.
Exact feature-set native archives and rootless images; checksums/SBOM/reproducibility.
Both native Linux architectures and rootless published UDP, exact packages and provisioned PHP.
Apple Silicon archive with independent H3 negotiation, PHP, reload/rejection and fallback evidence.
MSVC x64 ZIP, external UDP/firewall, external PHP, verified TLS, cleanup and fallback.
Independent implementations/browser, loss/MTU/reorder/overload and seamless address-change continuity without reconnect, replay or TCP fallback.
Validated examples, honest limitations, release gates require final-artifact evidence.
Full pentest, all native gates, mixed load, independent explicit tag authorization.
